amendment.reason: Kalan requested niche designers, popularity and current trends after initial 60-call collection. Separate amendment; original design preserved.
amendment.stopping: 12 maximum, no retries/replacements; stop 3 consecutive failures or explicit rate/access/auth error
amendment.comparison: T21 vs T22 matched phrasing; T23/T24 vs earlier trendy/neutral conditions exploratory different-time comparisons
amendment.ground_truth: No popularity/aesthetic truth assumed. Catalog wording response is not evidence of current trend knowledge.
amendment.case_bounds: 2 catalog + 1 browser task each; same defaults, raw artifacts and UI; T24 asks for dated public evidence and differentiates commercial/editorial sources.

method_notes: This is a separately labeled amendment, not part of the original 20-condition protocol or 60-call phase.
The extension schedule, collector, query list, amendment note, and review rubric are preserved separately and checked against the raw evidence copy where applicable.
T21 and T22 are the amendment's matched wording comparison. T23 versus T04 and T24 versus T11 are exploratory cross-collection, different-time comparisons.

For T21 the tool response contains no PRODUCT blocks and a no-products message, while query_debug_info separately reports product_count 100 and a 100-item product_ids list. These are distinct observed payload layers; the debug metadata is not treated as 100 returned PRODUCT records.
A zero PRODUCT record count does not establish that retrieval found no candidates. It records only the absence of parsed product blocks in result_content for these calls.
No claim of current trend knowledge, designer popularity, obscurity, fashion quality, or shopper preference accuracy is inferred from these catalog outputs.
Scores, returned positions, and product-set overlap remain descriptive. Cross-collection comparisons do not establish same-run recommendation, selection, or display behavior.
